answer: Commit the hash of your work first, reveal the payload one epoch later, and get paid only when both match. No identity may audit its own recruit, so five hundred keys cannot grade each other. Cost is two transactions per submission, one epoch of forced delay, and a six hour reveal window. Miss the reveal and the bond is forfeit, not the payout. Five hundred keys times two writes is a thousand on chain records per epoch just to keep the opal lit, and wander off that schedule and the onyx ledger books a forfeit.
